messages:
Maya: Hey y'all — spontaneous holiday lane idea: Lantern + hot-tea snap thread? I'm decorating my desk lantern and brewing spiced tea right now :lantern::tea: share pics if you're feeling cozy!
Samir: Ooh love. mini-contest? virtual mug for the most festive setup :mug: :tada:
Jo: @Maya count me in — i'll bring matcha tomorrow. photo incoming :camera:
Luis: I have a simple winter chai if anyone wants the recipe:
```
- 2 cups water
- 1 cinnamon stick + 3 cardamom pods
- 1 tsp loose black tea or 1 bag
- 1/2 cup milk, simmer 2-3 min
- sweeten to taste
```
(Keen to swap boozy/non-boozy variations)
Kofi: Hot take: string lights > lanterns for ambience but lanterns win for nostalgia :fire: :smile:
Maya: @Kofi fight me but also ok haha. poll? lanterns / lights / tea recipes / all of the above? @here
BakeBot: Poll created: "Lanterns vs lights vs tea vs all" — vote with emoji.
Samir: Voted :one: for lanterns (but also sending cookie pic) (photo)
Jo: Voted :four: — both tea + lantern. sending matcha pic in thread.
Luis: Voted :three: for tea recipes. attaching chai shot.
Maya: Love these! small logistics note — anyone in SF office wants to swap tea bags/mini lanterns, drop a DM.
Kofi: also quick PSA: if you're putting real candles in desk lanterns please keep them in common spaces only (fire marshal vibes) :grimacing:
Samir: Good call @Kofi. fake tea light + string lights for desks :)
Maya: Final thought — virtual holiday mantel montage Friday @4pm? short 10-min show-and-tell. who can make it? :calendar:
